Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification of the left hemithorax with contralateral (rightward) tracheal deviation, which is the classic radiographic sign of a massive pleural effusion exerting mass effect. Among the choices, this finding is most consistent with a large malignant effusion such as that seen in pleural metastases.
